options.reason: This is a transactional retail log with no plausible outcome column, so the natural aim is segmenting customers into behavioral groups from aggregated purchase features (recency, frequency, monetary value, product mix); timestamps are used only to build static features relative to an observation date, so no chronology column is set.
options.title: clustering

options.reason: Alternative aim: predict line-level quantity ordered from product, price and country, holding out rows per customer and using InvoiceDate for chronological validation.
